name: deck
description: 从参考文档生成一份 PPT。{input} = 主题 + 受众 + 大概几页
template:
Make a .pptx presentation. Brief: {input}

Follow the standard pipeline: confirm scope, locate sources (use kb_search if a knowledge library is registered, otherwise glob + read_file), draft outline, then write_pptx. Include section dividers between chapters and speaker notes per slide. Save as output/deck.pptx (or whatever path the user prefers).

name: report
description: 从参考文档生成一份 Word 报告。{input} = 主题 + 角度 + 篇幅
template:
Make a .docx report. Brief: {input}

Follow the standard pipeline: confirm scope, locate sources, draft outline (headings + key points), then write_docx with heading/paragraph/bullet/numbered blocks. Save as output/report.docx (or whatever path the user prefers).

name: outline
description: 只综合大纲不出文件（先看再决定）。{input} = 主题
template:
Synthesize an outline for: {input}

Locate sources (kb_search or glob+read), then propose a structured outline. For a deck: list slides with title + bullets + marked section dividers. For a report: list headings + 1-sentence summary each. Stop after the outline — wait for user approval before generating the actual file.

name: enrich
description: 用知识库内容丰富你上传的 PPT，产出保留原样式的新版本。{input} = 想补充的方向（可留空）
template:
Enrich the uploaded .pptx into a richer new version, preserving its design. Focus: {input}

Follow the enrich pipeline: read_pptx on the uploaded deck to get sN.F.P locators, kb_search topic-by-topic to find supporting content, plan the per-slide edits (which paragraphs to rewrite vs. where to add bullets), then edit_pptx writing to a new path (e.g. output/deck-enriched.pptx) so the original is untouched. Never delete slides or images — only rewrite and expand text. Verify with read_pptx and report the output path.

name: beautify
description: 统一并美化你上传的 PPT 排版（字体/字号/颜色/对齐/间距），保留原设计。{input} = 风格偏好（可留空）
template:
Beautify and unify the formatting of the uploaded .pptx, preserving its design. Style preference: {input}

Follow the beautify pipeline: read_pptx with with_format:true to audit current fonts/sizes/colors/alignment and spot inconsistencies, decide one coherent scheme (a single body font — prefer a CJK-capable font for Chinese decks — plus title/body size tiers, a text color, and consistent spacing), then apply it as a few broad format_pptx rules (scope all/title/body) writing to a new path (e.g. output/deck-pretty.pptx). format_pptx only rewrites text formatting — it never moves or resizes shapes, so flag any layout/overflow issues instead of pretending to fix them. Verify with read_pptx with_format:true and report the output path.

name: summarize
description: 总结你上传的 PPT，或生成演讲稿。{input} = 想要的形式（要点 / 演讲稿 / 摘要，可留空）
template:
Summarize the uploaded .pptx. Desired form: {input}

Read the deck text with read_file (or read_pptx if you need per-slide structure). If the user wants a short summary or talking points, answer directly in chat. If they want a full speech script (演讲稿), write_docx a standalone document (e.g. output/script.docx) with a heading per slide followed by the spoken paragraph(s). Do NOT write the script into the deck's speaker notes — keep it as a separate deliverable. Keep it in the speaker's voice, timed to the slides.
